title: Event Check-In Product System (QR + Python)
summary: A QR-based event check-in system with real-time tracking and dashboard reporting across 30+ rooms.
problem: Event operations needed a fast, reliable way to onboard attendees, track participation in real time, and provide stakeholders with clear reporting during and after events—without manual reconciliation.
approach: Gathered stakeholder requirements, designed the check-in workflow, and implemented a QR onboarding system with real-time participant tracking and a reporting dashboard for visibility across 30+ rooms.
outcome: Enabled real-time participant tracking and simplified event reporting with a workflow designed for speed, clarity, and operational reliability.
